dedupe_keys.name: geosmart infiltration potential sd50 suds infiltration suitability map

description: GeoSmart Infiltration Potential SD50 is a 50 m resolution map of how well the ground can accept infiltration from sustainable drainage systems, sold with a summary map for preliminary SuDS assessment. GeoSmart Information Ltd, a UK environmental data company, derives the capacity to receive infiltration from the nature, thickness and permeability of the ground and the depth to the high groundwater table. Coverage is Great Britain. Format and access: GIS data licensed from GeoSmart on quotation, also used in its site reports. Licence and cost: commercial, price on request. Caveats: a screening product that does not replace infiltration tests, and its groundwater inputs are modelled. It supports siting of soakaways, rain gardens and permeable surfaces, and climate adaptation of urban drainage. Related catalogue records are the BGS Infiltration SuDS Map, a comparable national product, and the CIRIA SuDS Manual.
